hypothesis: Can the desktop app reject invented evidence before Qwen writes the one answer shown to the owner?
implemented: Qwen extracts at most ten atomic claims with labelled exact quotes
ordinary code accepts only continuous exact substrings of known local excerpts
only accepted evidence reaches the final writer
the final answer may cite only accepted evidence IDs
internal extraction and writing prompts do not receive personality lore
the NLI stage has an explicit replaceable interface and returns unavailable instead of inventing a result
privacy: No private question, excerpt, quote, path, conversation ID or answer was published.
decision: Accept the exact-evidence backbone. Do not call DeBERTa active until the exact frozen checkpoint is exported, validated and packaged.
next_checkpoint: Export the accepted DeBERTa checkpoint to local ONNX, compare it with frozen reference decisions, then include it in the desktop build.
claim_boundary: This is a tested code checkpoint, not a physical Mac result. Exact substring checks prove provenance, not that the quote completely answers the question. DeBERTa weights are not yet packaged.
